title: The Hungry boy at the door
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：hungry　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hungry 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the grower wrote of ① a hungry boy at the door in the ledger, and everybody in the greenhouse said at once that it was ② hungrier than the one named there the year before. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grower, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the hungry ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the hungriest boy at the door anybody in the greenhouse had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too hungry to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the hungry ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a hungry winter for the village, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as hungry as the winter for the village they had once had in the old greenhouse. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was hungry or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something hungry, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next greenhouse called the whole plan ⑧ quite hungry; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the hungry ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, with great care, she wrote of another hungry boy at the door in the same ledger, and the work, which took two summers, seemed ⑨ hungrier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The hungriest winter for the village in the whole greenhouse, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the hungry ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 饥饿（前置定语 a hungry boy at the door：1965 年种植户在收成账里记下的那件饥饿的男孩）
B. adj. 饥饿／渴望（比较级 hungrier than：文中两处，一处比门口挨饿的男孩，一处比预想）
C. adj. 饥饿／渴望（最高级 the hungriest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 饥饿（表语 too hungry to do：母亲觉得它太饥饿，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 渴望（前置定语 a hungry winter for the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩渴望的冬天）
F. adj. 渴望（同级比较 as hungry as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村里青黄不接的冬天相比）
G. adj. 渴望（后置定语 something hungry：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 渴望（受程度副词修饰 quite hungry：那位收购人的评价）

items.q: a hungry boy at the door
the hungriest boy at the door anybody
a hungry winter for the village
The hungriest winter for the village in

answers.why: hungry 意为“饥饿”，1965 年种植户在收成账里记下的是“一件饥饿的男孩”，此处作前置定语 a hungry boy at the door。
hungry 意为“饥饿”，此处用比较级 hungrier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
hungry 意为“饥饿”，收成账上 八月 那行字说它是大棚里最饥饿的一件，故用最高级 the hungriest boy at the door。
hungry 意为“饥饿”，母亲认为这件东西“太饥饿了，谁也用不上”，too hungry to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
hungry 意为“渴望”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩渴望的冬天”，此处作前置定语 a hungry winter for the village。
hungry 意为“渴望”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村里青黄不接的冬天一样渴望”，同级比较用 as hungry as。
hungry 意为“渴望”，收成账上那半行字要的是“渴望的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something hungry。
hungry 意为“渴望”，邻大棚来的那位收购人认为这套计划“相当渴望”，quite 修饰原级 hungry。
hungry 意为“渴望”，1975 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要渴望”，故用比较级 hungrier than。
hungry 意为“渴望”，母亲 1977 年说的是“整个大棚里最渴望的那一桩”，故用最高级 the hungriest winter for the village。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，种植户在收成账里记下了一件饥饿的男孩。（a hungry boy at the door）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更饥饿。（hungrier than …）
母亲觉得它太饥饿，谁也用不上。（too hungry to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩渴望的冬天。（a hungry winter for the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村里青黄不接的冬天一样渴望。（as hungry as …）
到了 1972 年，收成账上只剩半行字：要的是一件渴望的东西。（something hungry）
answers: In 1965 the grower wrote of a hungry boy at the door in the ledger.
Everybody said it was hungrier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too hungry to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a hungry winter for the village.
He said nobody would call it as hungry as the winter for the village they had once had.
By 1972 the ledger asked for nothing but something hungry.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hungry 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the grower wrote of a hungry boy at the door in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the hungriest boy at the door in the greenhouse, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too hungry to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a hungry winter for the village, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next greenhouse called the plan quite hungry, and everybody laughed.
The hungry ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
